title: Summarizing an array
summary: Largest so far, totals, and stopping early.

steps.title: Largest so far
steps.say: Start with the first value, then replace it whenever you find a bigger one.

steps.title: Stop as soon as you know
steps.say: `contains` can `return true` the moment it finds the target. It only returns false after checking everything.

steps.title: Average
steps.say: Total the values, then divide. Watch out for integer division!

marks.label: a for-each loop: every value, no index

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `public static int max` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find public static int max with Ctrl+F.
